narrative.details:
A little further investigation shows a panel that slides open. Clearly written above some wiring is the statement, "Replace Mithril Casing And Turn Power Off Then On."

Taking a moment to replace the panel, you wonder if it'll be that simple to fix A-Me 01 and get her back to Karna Remtravel near Marshall's Refuge.

Only trying it will tell.
narrative.objectives: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.
narrative.offerRewardText: You remove the panel from A-Me 01's back yet again and carefully remove the old mithril casing that seems to have burnt out. The new one slides into place easily. The only thing left to do, assuming the mithril casing was the problem, is to flip the switch to the "Off" position, and then back to the "On" position.
narrative.requestItemsText: The panel in which the mithril casing goes is still closed shut. The rest of A-Me 01 remains inert.
